question:
In the given figure, O is the centre of the circle. ∠POQ = 54°. What is the measure (in degree) of ∠PRQ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5011d381ff2dfa728db3aa3d4bc86735e5afd9c70c586e714b3872ec2a5fd9d9.png]
solution:
**Given:**

∠POQ = 54°

**Concept used:**

The angle subtended by an arc at the centre is double the angle subtended by it at any point on the remaining part of the circle.

The sum of the opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral = 180°
